sentences.text: Mengciusornis honors the Chinese philosopher Mencius, with a species name meaning 'toothed' in Latin.
Unlike its toothless relative Schizooura, this dinosaur possessed large, curved teeth on its upper jaw.
Fossil remains were discovered in the Jiufotang Formation, represented by a single well-preserved skeleton specimen that includes feather remains.
The animal belongs to the family Schizoouridae, a group that also includes the closely related genus Schizooura.
This basal ornithuromorph dinosaur lived in China during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
